recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7297; any future ClinicalAssessment.finding.item changes should be made in the Patient Care incubator IG or through a current core migration issue if the resource returns to core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification request for ClinicalImpression.finding.item to support a CodeableConcept, a reference to Condition, or a reference to Observation.
initial_application: SVN #9058 appears in git as 127b8fa271, tagged with [#7297], and changed ClinicalImpression.finding.item from CodeableConcept-only to item[x] with CodeableConcept | Reference(Condition | Observation), with matching finding-code and finding-ref search parameter updates.
additional_context: Later refactors converted the element to CodeableReference while preserving Condition and Observation target profiles. FHIR-14150 later expanded the same target family and is already audited on the combined branch. FHIR-46596 renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment, and fad1b9cf84 removed ClinicalAssessment from the active fhir.ini resource list while pointing active core pages to the Patient Care incubator IG.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. The current core checkout should not be edited or reactivated for this seed because ClinicalImpression/ClinicalAssessment is out of the active core build, and both the retained source lineage and the PC incubator CI artifact already allow Condition and Observation references for finding.item.
